terminology.text: All players ante before cards are dealt. No pre-flop betting; action starts at the flop.
Maximum bet or raise cannot exceed the current pot size.
Two separate community boards are dealt; the pot typically splits between the winners of each.
Big blind. The standard betting unit; 1BB is the minimum bet for that game.
